definitions.description: Holds personal data about a natural person; subject to access and erasure requests.
Feeds the general ledger or a financial report; changes are audited.
Slowly changing data that many transactions reference.
High-churn business documents created by day-to-day operations.
Expected to exceed ten million rows; partitioning and archiving candidates.
Exchanged with an external system (carrier, bank, EDI partner or marketplace).
Maintained by administrators to configure how the business runs.
